answer: Every identity is a chain. Each attestation is hash-linked to its predecessor, so its history becomes a Merkle spine. Fresh accounts start at depth zero; transactions need twelve links, earned one per epoch. A cloned wallet has no history. Forging a twelve-deep spine means buying twelve past signatures, each tied to a real account. At four hundred POA each, that is forty-eight thousand POA against a payout under a thousand. A lighthouse on a remote island fitted with a prism lens: the real beacon refracts its history into one clean spectrum, and the juniper smoke marks the true harbor.
